role: GLOBAL ANCHOR - the programme's research objective. All other documents are subordinate.
objective_is: sections 0.1 (thesis), 0.3 (LIMEN) and 0.4 (claim, mechanism, objective, non-claim). A document disagreeing with those is drift, not a variant.
does_not_anchor: instruments, toolboxes, run logs, review records - admitted on the three criteria in docs/INSTRUMENT_POSTURE.md and used as shipped
rendered_manifest: viz/manuscript.html (generated; carries this sha256 in its header)
equation_apparatus: All 9 display equations carry the three-part apparatus a journal reader needs: a purpose sentence, the equation, and a note defining every symbol in terms the protocol already defines elsewhere. Equation numbers are implicit in document order; the renderer emits them.
